description: This file defines a custom exception class PolicyIdNotModifiableException used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when an operation attempting to modify a policy ID on a Thing fails due to insufficient permissions. The class includes builder methods, JSON parsing capabilities, and metadata annotations, and extends DittoRuntimeException while implementing ThingException.

classes.name: PolicyIdNotModifiableException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating failure to modify a Policy ID due to permission issues, with builder support and JSON parsing.
